gallery.title: File:20111110-OC-UNK-6259 - Flickr - USDAgov.jpg
gallery.description: Agriculture Secretary Tom Vilsack spoke to farmers, ranchers, and business owners in Kansas City, Mo., on Thursday, Nov. 10, 2011. The U. S. Department of Agriculture has streamlined a large number of programs and processes in an effort to help local farmers, ranchers and businesses continue to drive America's productive agricultural economy. As USDA approaches its 150th anniversary, the changes in quicker disaster assistance, expedited reviews of pending product applications, and less reporting date will help USDA build a better, stronger and more efficient Department.  Photo by USDA.
